description: This file defines the 'Shadow' class, which models the shadow effect for worksheet drawing elements, including properties like visibility, blur radius, distance, direction, alignment, color, and transparency. It provides methods for getting and setting these properties.

classes.name: Shadow
classes.description: Represents the shadow effect for drawing objects within a worksheet, allowing configuration of visual properties such as visibility, blur, offset, angle, color, and transparency.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Shadow object with default property values.

methods.name: getVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the shadow is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the shadow.

methods.name: getBlurRadius
methods.description: Returns the blur radius of the shadow.

methods.name: setBlurRadius
methods.description: Sets the blur radius of the shadow.

methods.name: getDistance
methods.description: Returns the distance of the shadow.

methods.name: setDistance
methods.description: Sets the distance of the shadow.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction (in degrees) of the shadow.

methods.name: setDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction (in degrees) of the shadow.

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.description: Returns the alignment of the shadow.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment of the shadow.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the color object of the shadow.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the shadow.

methods.name: getAlpha
methods.description: Returns the alpha transparency of the shadow.

methods.name: setAlpha
methods.description: Sets the alpha transparency of the shadow.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current state of the shadow object.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the shadow object.
